method_note: Existing gm_materials and reddit signals; no new metric, experiment, numeric weighting or active rating input.

sampling.strategy: Purposeful source discovery; maximum three author/project cases
queries: Shadowdark hexcrawl campaign map blog session
sampling.stop_rule: Three bounded cases, with at least one primary authored map workflow and a played-status discriminator; no further scan.

source.locator: Trendalor; The hexmap, paragraphs on module placement and hand drawing (retrieved lines34–92)

observations.observed_fact: Author describes a current Shadowdark campaign, a hand-drawn regional map and adapting multiple existing adventures into one coastal region. A later article reports play in the same campaign.
observations.interpretation: Direct L1 preparation and development example; mixed original connective geography plus reused adventures, not wholly original content or an independent instance per module.
limitations: Self-report and purposeful discovery, no denominator or conversion rate.
Hand drawing and simple sketches already work; no stated intent to adopt HexCrawl.
No precise core printing; images and linked player guide not inspected.
Reddit promo and follow-up are the same author/project, not independent users.

corroboration.locator: paragraphs describing current campaign and player reactions, lines43–55

source.locator: first and second game report; final paragraph beginning I still need to build a map

observations.observed_fact: Author reports Shadowdark play with B5 in Karameikos and says they made a custom regional map; a fort map remains to be made.
observations.interpretation: Supports redrawing/adapting an existing setting, not proof of new-world generation. Lower access confidence than the two fully retrieved cases.
limitations: Initial primary page opening and primary-source search extract available; follow-up page retrieval blocked by Google challenge.
Custom-map assertion available in expanded search extract; linked map not visually inspected.
Existing Mystara geography; do not classify as wholly original geography.
Self-report, no population denominator or verified adoption.

source.locator: Brief context; Game World; Hex crawling and point crawling; u/EnjoysBooks9001; lines19–20,52,75–92

observations.observed_fact: Author reports 41 sessions over about 15 months, populating a baseline archipelago map with modules and homebrew. They explicitly describe actual travel as pointcrawl and moving to Stonehell after about 15 sessions.
observations.interpretation: L1 map population/editing is supported; 41 sessions cannot be counted as 41 hexcrawl sessions or 41 creators. Counterexample to equating West Marches label with hex-based play.
observations.unit: sessions in one author-reported campaign, not hexcrawl sessions
observations.period: about 15 months, author reported; calendar endpoints unverified
observations.geography_language: English; local table location not established
limitations: Search gives 2026-10-18 but opened page says 5d ago; publication date left unknown.
Crossposts r/osr/1x94a22 and r/rpg/1x92jc4 are the same campaign, not additional authors.
Baseline map origin/license and map images not examined.
Self-reported sessions, not independently audited; no unique-GM market denominator.
Later megadungeon play is not regional hexcrawl demand.

findings: Direct preparation/play evidence exists for creating connective geography and populating/redrawing existing regions.
Most evidence here fits develop; it must not silently raise p_create.
A campaign can use maps and West Marches conventions while playing as pointcrawl and later megadungeon.
Hand drawing, sketches and existing maps are viable alternatives; unmet need and willingness to adopt remain unknown.

development_link.interpretation: Useful qualitative workflow evidence for the approved vision of joining modules and editing maps. No rule extracted; no binding, criterion, task scope or acceptance amended. Terrain-neighbor generation047 alone is not evidence of solving this module-assembly workflow.
development_link.reason: GM practice is not a normative game rule. Existing source matrices and common-rule registries remain authoritative; do not encode a blog preference as a mandatory Shadowdark profile.
development_link.runtime_support: unknown; no product executed in this slice

unknowns: Audience denominator and frequency of original map creation
Willingness to use another tool versus current sketches/maps
Exact printing and independent session verification
